tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind panels, the app shell background.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tables, inputs, popovers. The default reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table header, hover rows, subtle fills, code wells.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, panel and card outlines. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, dividers that carry meaning. 3:1 or more on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface-* and *-soft token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, placeholders, table headers. 4.5:1 or more on every surface-*.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, selected nav item, active tab indicator, the icon disc inside primary buttons. Text-safe on surface-* (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (the icon disc of a primary button).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: the one main action of a view. Ink, so domain and brand colours keep their meaning.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of the primary button.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on an action fill. 14:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: action-accent
tokens.usage: The icon disc inside a primary button: the mark's dot on the action. 3.3:1 on action in light, 4.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-action-accent
tokens.usage: Icon on the action-accent disc (5.5:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected nav background, info callouts. Pair with brand or ink text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element. 3:1+ on all surfaces.

tokens.name: asset
tokens.usage: Domain color for ITAM: asset record refs, asset icons, asset counters. Same family as the mark's blue stem. Independent of the brand colour, which is customisable (#157).

tokens.name: asset-soft
tokens.usage: Background of asset record chips and the asset row in relation panels. Independent of the brand colour, which is customisable (#157).

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Domain color for the service desk: ticket refs and icons. The violet dot of the mark: tickets are the point where assets and projects meet.

tokens.name: desk-soft
tokens.usage: Background of ticket record chips. desk text on it is 5:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: project
tokens.usage: Domain color for projects and tasks: project refs, icons, progress bars. Text-safe green, darker than the logo green.

tokens.name: project-soft
tokens.usage: Background of project and task record chips.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Resolved, in stock, completed. Always with a word or icon: it sits close to project in hue.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, SLA at risk, warranty expiring, high priority. Text-safe amber.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and callouts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Urgent priority, SLA breached, destructive actions, field errors.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and error callouts.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the global search palette.

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Identity only: the mark's blue stem (gradient #17a7fd to #0d62fc), cover and marketing blocks. Not for UI states or text.

tokens.name: logo-violet
tokens.usage: Identity only: the mark's violet dot (gradient #7a4cf8 to #6a3df6) and the violet app icon tile. Not for UI states.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: Identity only: the mark's green stem (gradient #28d5a4 to #1aaf94). Fails as text on light grounds (2.3:1): never use it for text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Login screen and empty-state heroes only. One per screen. Unbounded is wide: keep it to short lines.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page title: module index pages (Assets, Service desk, Projects).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Record title in a detail view: the asset, ticket or project name. Truncate past one line.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Panel and card headings, dialog titles. Instrument Sans, not Unbounded: these sit inside dense UI.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form text: ticket descriptions, knowledge notes, comments.
styles.sample: The laptop does not wake from sleep after the last update.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, form values, lists.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body: names, row primary column, selected nav.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text, tab labels, nav items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table column headers, badge text, counters, nav sections. Uppercase with tracking for headers.

styles.name: record-id
styles.usage: Record identifiers: AST-0142, TCK-1093, PRJ-012. Martian Mono runs wide, so it is set a step smaller than body.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Serial numbers, MAC and IP addresses, hostnames, inventory tags, the app version.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips; badge padding inline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding inline, table cell padding inline, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding, gap between panels in a column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, section gap inside a detail view.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter, gap between page title and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state and login vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Record chips, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, dialogs, the search palette.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App icon tile and marketing blocks only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, progress bars, badges and other status/environment markers.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on surface-0 (optional; the border is the primary edge).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, hover cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the global search palette, over scrim.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs inside tables and toolbars.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Login form and primary page actions.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Default table row height.

tokens.name: size-row-compact
tokens.usage: Dense table rows (asset inventory with many columns).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Expanded app sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, badges and table cells.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Nav icons and standalone icon buttons.
